items.text:
| Test                                                              | Result                                            |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| add sodium hydroxide solution                                     | no visible reaction but the test-tube became warm |
| add dilute hydrochloric acid                                      | no reaction                                       |
| add dilute hydrochloric acid followed by barium chloride solution | no reaction                                       |
| add nitric acid followed by silver nitrate solution               | white precipitate                                 |
